angles.copy: Creamfields North is just around the corner! Get ready for three days of the biggest dance anthems and electrifying sets. Who's making the pilgrimage to Daresbury?

angles.copy: Thinking Bank Holiday? Think Creamfields! If you're heading to Cheshire for the ultimate dance party, let us know your favourite DJ!

moments.blurb: Roland Orzabal, co-founder, guitarist, and co-lead vocalist of the iconic 80s band Tears for Fears, celebrates his 65th birthday today, August 22nd.

angles.copy: Everybody Wants To Rule The World... and today we're celebrating Roland Orzabal's 65th birthday! An absolute icon of classic pop.

moments.title: Julian Casablancas Turns 48

angles.name: Classic Rock Icon
angles.copy: From the stage to the screen, Gene Simmons is a true rock icon. Wishing the KISS legend a very Happy 77th Birthday on Tuesday!
